body_lead: - Kalvakuntla Kavitha highlights AI job loss and seeks new law - Kalvakuntla Kavitha criticizes Telangana government over handloom orders - Kalvakuntla Kavitha warns of protest to protect workers Kalvakuntla Kavitha has raised concerns over rising job losses due to artificial intelligence and called for immediate policy intervention. She suggested that a structured legal framework is necessary to address the growing impact of AI on employment across sectors. In a public statement, she proposed a three level approach to tackle AI job loss.
